domains.name: Case Identification
domains.summary: Unique identifiers and case creation details including birth certificate number, date of notification, case number assembly, version, and internal database ID.

domains.name: Demographics and Dates
domains.summary: Dates of birth and death, age at death, days lived, and related categorical variables such as age categories and disability status.

domains.name: Residence Information
domains.summary: Address details including apartment number, city, county, state, street name, zip code, and residence type.

domains.name: Health Conditions
domains.summary: Prior disabilities or chronic illnesses categorized by cognitive, mental health/substance abuse, physical/orthopedic, sensory issues, and special healthcare needs services.

domains.name: Date Components
domains.summary: Specific components of date of birth (month, day, year) and date of death (month, day, year), along with unknown status flags for both dates.

domains.name: Ethnicity and Race
domains.summary: Ethnicity, race categories including American Indian, Alaska Native, Asian, Black/African American, Native Hawaiian, Pacific Islander, multi-racial, and unknown status flags.

domains.name: Child Identification
domains.summary: First name, middle name, last name of the child, and unknown status flag for names.

domains.name: Physical Attributes
domains.summary: Height in centimeters, feet, inches, and unknown status flags; weight in numeric value, grams, ounces, pounds, and unknown status flags.
